items.source: Registers a bean definition for SpringDataWebSettings carrying the configuration values of EnableSpringDataWebSupport.

items.source: Marker interface to describe configuration classes that ship Jackson modules that are supposed to be added to the Jackson 3 ObjectMapper configured for EnableSpringDataWebSupport.
items.translation: 标记接口，用于描述随 Jackson 模块一起分发的配置类，这些模块旨在添加到为EnableSpringDataWebSupport配置的 Jackson 3 ObjectMapper中。
